payload.text: THE SHARED SET'S LAST REBUILD (vc, 2026-11-20 09:22Z by date -u): once more, at main AFTER WP-14 lands and BEFORE WP-06 lands, booked at the Desk in a gap between cc's runs, never beside cc's suite or gate.
